note: Official trophy names and descriptions as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are original text written for this entry; each guide names the sources its facts come from.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the Strangers & Freaks strands — and this one follows on its own. Expect roughly 200 hours in total, most of it on the 100% checklist for A Long Road. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PushSquare trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish Gone Fishing, Jason's opening mission in Chapter 1, and it pops at the mission's end. No preparation needed. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PushSquare trophy guide.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Play through every mission of Chapter 1 and it pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house after the mission Down to Earth — it is the one interaction tied to the possibly missable Positive Mental Attitude. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PushSquare trophy guide.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish every mission of Chapter 2 and it pops at the chapter's end. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter, since there is no mission replay if you want to revisit anything. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PushSquare trophy guide.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish every mission of Chapter 3 and it pops at the chapter's end. Use the story run to try activities as they unlock — each new activity type counts toward Master of None. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PushSquare trophy guide.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish every mission of Chapter 4 and it pops at the chapter's end. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is... unlocks the eight large bank vaults during this chapter — leave the vault robberies until it appears. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish the final story mission and it pops. After the credits, free roam continues, so every open-world trophy can still be earned — nothing is locked behind the ending. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PushSquare trophy guide.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story and it pops at the mission's end. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story and it pops at the mission's end. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the mission Child's Play when it appears in the story and it pops at the mission's end. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the mission Headliners when it appears in the story and it pops at the mission's end. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story and it pops at the mission's end. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story and it pops at the mission's end. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest and longest trophy: reach 100% on the in-game checklist at Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. You do not need everything — only the checklist's numbers: finish the story, 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, fence $100,000 of narcotics and jewelry, $250,000 of marked bills and $200,000 of vehicles, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 50 of 66 weapons, 100 of 255 animals studied, 30 of 40 races won, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 of 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and all 15 of Bret's target decks. Check the list after the story and clean up only what is left. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide and 100% checklist; GTABase trophy list; PushSquare trophy guide.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the game's stunt jumps and air tricks; each unique one counts once. Do them as you travel instead of saving them all for the end, and note the 100% checklist wants 300 of 397 stunts, so keep going past 250. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. The nine are the game's activity families — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, drone races and hunting are the ones the guides name. Sample each one as it unlocks during the story and the trophy pops on the ninth. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Gold medals need a fast, accurate run at each range — learn the target pattern, use the weapon the range gives you, and retry a range until the gold threshold shows. This is also a 100% checklist item, so it counts twice toward the platinum. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PushSquare trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own drone time trial as well — the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone time trials finished, so run the trial at a location right after you win its race. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different race events count — winning the same race twice does not add to the total. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge — it is a head-to-head fishing contest, so land the bigger catch before the timer ends. Fishing also feeds the 100% checklist indirectly through activities, so it is worth learning early. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Walk up to an arcade cabinet in Leonida, play a game to its end, and the trophy pops. The 100% checklist wants all 4 video games played, so try the other cabinets too while you are there. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission, the last step of his Stranger mission strand. Andy's missions unlock as you meet him around Leonida — follow his strand to its end and the trophy pops on the final mission. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission, the last step of his Stranger mission strand. Kenton's strand is also tied to his treasure sets — the 100% checklist wants 5 of 7 treasure sets, so his missions and his collectibles overlap. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission, the last step of his Stranger mission strand. Follow Billy's strand as it appears and finish its final mission to pop this. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying Stranger mission strands. Stranger missions are the side strands given by characters like Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each finished strand counts one. There are more than eight strands in the game, so pick the eight whose missions you enjoy and finish them. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PushSquare trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission, the last step of his Stranger mission strand. Follow Randy's strand as it appears and finish its final mission to pop this. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission, the last step of his Stranger mission strand. Follow Tyrone's strand as it appears and finish its final mission to pop this. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 required spots across Leonida. This is the only trophy the guides flag as possibly missable: one meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, where Lucia invites you to meditate on the balcony after the mission Down to Earth — accept her invitation and finish that meditation before leaving Chapter 1. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, but this trophy needs all 18. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list; PowerPyx via EGamers.io.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks you to track down specific animals — follow his missions, find the marked animal, and take it down cleanly. The 100% checklist wants all 15 of Bret's target decks finished, so his strand is worth completing in full. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a finished set is one where you hold every card in it. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so collect well past three. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan vehicles and landmarks as you meet them — every new scan counts. The 100% checklist wants exactly 100 scans, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Scan from the start of the story to avoid a long cleanup. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges are small feats across combat, driving, exploration and activities — the game tracks 80 in total. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so aim past 50 and let the checklist carry you to the rest. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat dies down. A fast car and the countryside help more than the city. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each in turn, and keep the wanted level alive between them — do not let it clear before the third robbery. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count when you find them in the world or scan them with the WAiNK app — the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning every new car you see. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus when a group of enemies is close together and chain the takedowns before the focus ends — a gang shootout or a police ambush gives you the targets you need. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport. Get onto the runway as a plane is leaving, board it, and take off. Time it with a departure and expect a wanted level — this is a secret trophy, so the guides list it among the hidden ones. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; Leonida Hub trophy list.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.description: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat.
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Find a Rhino at a military site, steal it, and fire its cannon at enemies or vehicles. Expect a heavy police response, so take the tank somewhere open before you start fighting. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; Leonida Hub trophy list.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the robbery quietly: slip in, take the jewelry, and leave before any alarm or witness spots you. A stealthy approach with your partner on lookout works better than smashing the cases. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. The eight large bank vaults unlock with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is... in Chapter 4 — rob any five of them and get away clean. The 100% checklist wants all eight, so keep going after the fifth. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PushSquare trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash, and lose the police. Armored trucks patrol Leonida's roads, so watch for one while you travel and strike when the road is clear. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, fly and walk through every region until the map is fully revealed — the coasts, the swamps, the cities and the countryside. Pair it with WAiNK scans and vehicle discovery, since exploring naturally feeds both. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Gang operations are the crew-run illegal businesses across Leonida — the 100% checklist wants all 39 of them done, so this trophy comes naturally while you work through that list. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach. Find a bar or spot with a view over Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it there. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guides, so try the beachfront bars first. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.guide: Escape from a vehicle showroom. The exact method is still unconfirmed by the guides — the trophy's name points to a showroom escape, so try stealing a car from a showroom and getting away. Check back with the cited guides as players confirm the trigger. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Steal the three key valuables at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and escape.
trophies.guide: Steal the three key valuables at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and escape. Get into the bowling alley, take all three valuables, and leave without getting caught. Plan your exit before you grab the last one. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.description: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia.
trophies.guide: Maximize the strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Build strength through the game's gym and physical activities — train with each character in turn until both bars are full. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.description: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Criminal Profile actions are the crimes and illicit activities the game tracks — robberies, heists, fencing and the like all count. Play the game as a criminal and the number climbs on its own; the 100% grind alone covers a large share of it. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: A hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose unlock method is still unconfirmed. The guides list it as hidden with no confirmed trigger yet — treat it as a watch item and check the cited guides as players confirm what sets it off. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.description: A hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose unlock method is still unconfirmed. The guides list it as hidden with no confirmed trigger yet — treat it as a watch item and check the cited guides as players confirm what sets it off. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.guide: Perform the required melee drive-by elimination. The precise method is still being confirmed by the guides — it involves taking out a target with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Check the cited guides as players confirm the exact trigger. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; GTABase trophy list.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — fence them through your contacts and the total builds up. The 100% checklist also wants $250,000 of marked bills fenced, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear — every purchase counts toward the total. The money from robberies and fencing gives you more than enough, so spend as you play rather than saving it all for the end. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida — each one you buy counts, and the eighth purchase pops the trophy. Save up from robberies and fencing; garages are also useful for storing the vehicles you discover. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register vehicles you own or find — ten registrations pops the trophy. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; EGamers.io trophy list.
trophies.name: On the Spot
